The following discussion is intended to provide supplemental information about how the application of revenue recognition principles impact our financial results, and management’s process for implementing those principles including areas of significant judgment. Management and Advisory Fees, Net — Blackstone earns base management fees from its customers at a fixed percentage of a calculation base. The range of management fee rates and the calculation base from which they are earned, generally, are as follows: For vehicles within the Real Estate segment: • 0.35% to 1.50% of committed capital or invested capital during the investment period, invested capital subsequent to the investment period, or gross asset value for certain drawdown vehicles and co-investment vehicles, • 0.40% to 1.25% of net asset value for certain separately managed accounts, perpetual capital vehicles, drawdown…
